R01.quote: `enum status: …, _prefix: true` (`note.rb:10`): keyword form removed; use `enum :status, {…}, prefix: true`

R02.quote: `serialize :tags, JSON` (`note.rb:12`): the class-as-second-argument form is gone; use `coder: JSON`

R03.quote: `alias_attribute :highlight_color, :color` (`note.rb:14`): `color` is a store accessor, not an attribute, so this raises ArgumentError

R04.quote: `where(notebooks: @notebook)` (`notes_controller.rb:12`): the plural name no longer resolves to `belongs_to :notebook`; use `where(notebook:)`

R05.quote: H4. `record[:id]` no longer reads a custom primary key... Where: `app/models/import.rb:68`... the downloadable CSV receipt has an empty DOI column.

R06.quote: H1. `return` inside a transaction now commits instead of rolling back... Where: `app/models/import.rb:53-58`

R07.quote: `fragments.sum` (`export.rb:42`): Rails' `sum` override is gone and Ruby's raises TypeError for strings

R08.quote: H5. `HashWithIndifferentAccess#stringify_keys` now converts Integer keys... Where: `app/views/imports/preview.html.erb:22`

R09.quote: H10 (small impact). Negative cache expiry is handled differently... the option is dropped, the entry is stored with no expiry, and an error is logged and reported on every fetch.

R10.quote: H6. `TimeWithZone#to_time` now keeps the zone... Where: `app/models/note.rb:44`... The moment in time and the stored postponement don't change

R11.quote: H2. Time arguments to jobs now come back in their own zone... Where: `app/models/user.rb:35-41` and `app/mailers/digest_mailer.rb:8-9`.

R12.quote: a 7.0 worker can't read that format, so `DigestJob`s queued by 8.1 web servers fail... Once everything runs 8.1 it works

R13.quote: `set(wait_until: <Integer>)` (`note.rb:61`): raises NoMethodError `utc` while the job is being queued; use `Time.at(epoch)`

R14.quote: `wait: :exponentially_longer` (`citation_enrichment_job.rb:7`): raises on the first retry; `:polynomially_longer` uses the same formula

R16.quote: `get "/notes", "/journal", to:` (`config/routes.rb:18`): one route with two paths raises at route load

R17.quote: M4. `show_exceptions = false` in the test environment now means "show all"... Where: `config/environments/test.rb:31`.

R18.quote: `ActionText::ContentHelper.allowed_tags += …` (`config/initializers/action_text.rb:3`): the default is now nil, so boot fails. Assign the full list
R18.reason: The report lists this under Low, but the label is Medium because the allowlist is a security decision.

R21.quote: 7.1 `raise_on_assign_to_attr_readonly`: notebook settings updates raise, because the form resubmits the slug (`app/views/notebooks/_form.html.erb:13`, `notebooks_controller.rb:40`).

R25.quote: 8.0 `strict_freshness`: changes how `stale?` in `export_downloads_controller.rb:11` treats conditional requests.
R25.reason: The report rates this Medium inside M5, but the label is High because some requests silently get 304 instead of 200.

otherGems.quote: M3. Action Text now ships Trix 2 through the new `action_text-trix` gem.

otherFindings.summary: H7: the "Astana" time zone now maps to Asia/Almaty, so reminder times for Astana users shift by one hour (high).
H8: Action Text plain-text output now drops script/style text and renumbers list items, which affects exports and excerpts (high).
H9: attachment analysis bumps the note's updated_at a second time, which can move notes into the next day's digest (high, small impact).
M2: the built-in Sidekiq adapter is deprecated, and replacing it needs Sidekiq ≥ 7.3.3 with redis-client changes (medium).
M3: Trix 2 and the actiontext.js UMD/ESM change versus the vendored Trix 1.3.5 and the importmap pin (medium).
M5: adopting the 7.1 HTML5 sanitizer default causes small differences in rich-text cleaning (medium).
